interface.name: hyprion_grade_manager_v1

description.summary: create compositor-side colour grades for a surface

interface.description:
Hyprion draws a sampled OKLab colour grade in the compositor, using the same framebuffer source as its window effects. The client supplies only an area and a style; no pixels cross the protocol.
Grades are surface-local and clipped to the surface that owns them. The capabilities event describes the area modes this compositor implements. Pixels are always sampled from the framebuffer after the surface has been drawn; blur is requested separately through ext-background-effect-v1.

request.name: get_grade

description.summary: create a grade object for a surface

request.description: Multiple grade objects may be attached to the same surface. They are rendered in creation order.

interface.name: hyprion_grade_v1
interface.description: Coordinates are surface-local logical pixels. The box is the glazed surface; the area selects inset, outset, both, or fill. The grade is clipped to the owning surface and never paints outside it.

entry.name: replace
entry.summary: interpolate the sampled pixel and the graded result

description.summary: whether this surface can carry a compositor grade

arg.name: supported
arg.summary: 1 when the surface role is supported

description.summary: select how the graded result combines with the framebuffer
